candidates.source_date_field: HPD release date and statement that officials celebrated New Yorkers moving into affordable homes.
candidates.architect: Marvel Architects, BFC Partners, Breaking Ground, and Bedford Union Armory redevelopment project team
candidates.project_type: mixed-income affordable housing opening on adaptive reuse campus
candidates.geometry_source: Approximate point for 1101 and 1089 President Street / Bedford Union Armory residential site from source address terms.

candidates.attribution: NYC Department of Housing Preservation and Development
